scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text:
Welcome to Ayothaya.
Our beautiful village is built
above the water, surrounded
by a dense forest.

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text: There are many tourist attractions in this village that you won't be able to find anywhere else. Our fish markets and the unique architecture of our buildings are enough reason to visit Ayotaya.

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text:
Please feel free
to take a look around.

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text:
At our Weapon Shop,
you will find great weapons
favored by brave Ayothayan seafarers.

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text:
Our Weapon Shop
is located at ^55FF33+^000000.

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text: We Ayothayans always make sure we have everything we need before we go traveling. It never hurts to be prepared, doesn't it?

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text:
Our Tool Shop
is located at ^3355FF+^000000.

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text: One of the basics of adventuring is gathering information, or at least that's what they say. You can meet people from all sorts of places in the Tavern. I'm sure you can learn something useful there.

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text:
Of course, you must
drop by our Tavern.
It is located at ^00FF00+^000000.

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text:
If you wish to pray to God, or achieve a state of peace in your mind, why don't you visit our Shrine? Even if it's just for sight-seeing, everyone is
welcome there.

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text:
Our Shrine
is located at ^00FF00+^000000.

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text: Since Ayothaya was built above the surface of the water and close to a beach, it's been a favorite spot for fishermen. Why don't you catch some fish for dinner at the Fishing Spot?

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text:
Our famous
Fishing Spot
is located at ^00FF00+^000000

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text: If you wish to remove location marks on your mini-map, please select the 'Remove marks from mini-map' command from the menu.

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text:
Alright...
I've removed all the
location marks from
your mini-map.
Thank you.

scripts.speaker: Noi
scripts.text:
Please enjoy
your travels.
